content:
ben: Quick heads-up: onboarding sample-app using node SDK v1.7.2 shows different behavior vs curl for the search endpoint in private clusters. SDK returns 403; curl returns 200.
mei: Do you have the requests you ran?
ben: curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Team: team-blue" -d '{"q":"status","use_cache":false}' https://private.api.redwood.local/v1/search
```
SDK (node):
```js
await client.search.create({ q: 'status', useCache: false })
```
sam: Two things here: SDK camelCases `useCache` (private expects `use_cache`) and it renames `X-Team` to `X-Tenant-Id` on private envs. Public proxy accepts both so the issue only shows up in private.
ben: Right, sandbox logs show the private gateway rejected the tenant header and the backend defaulted `use_cache` to true -> stale results.
mei: Short-term workaround: use `client.search.create({ request_body: { q: 'status', use_cache: false }, headers: { 'X-Team': 'team-blue' } })`. Longer-term: we should preserve snake_case for critical fields and not rename tenant headers for private by default.
sam: Also flag: SDK auto-retries 401 by refreshing tokens which caused multiple 401s and tripped our private circuit breaker during repro. curl sees a single 401. We should disable auto-retry-on-401 for private by default (feature flag).
infra-bot: Created issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/10012 (preserve snake_case + header rename revert) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/10013 (circuit breaker diagnostic).
devex-bot: Suggested action items: 1) Patch serializer to keep server-critical field names (assigned to sam). 2) Add SDK env flag REDWOOD_PASSTHROUGH_HEADERS for private to stop header renames. 3) Add private smoke E2E comparing raw payloads (assigned to mei).
ben: Thanks. I'll update the sample-app README with the request_body workaround and add a CI check to catch this parity drift.
